newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Italy's Cerruti extends licence to Indonesia.
newsitem.headline: Italy's Cerruti extends licence to Indonesia.

text.p: Italian fashion house Nino Cerruti signed an extension to its licensing agreement with PT Great River International on Tuesday which will make the Indonesian company the hub of its Southeast Asian operations.

Great River, which since 1994 has been licensed to produce and sell Cerruti clothing in Indonesia, Malaysia and Singapore, was given a territorial extension by the new agreement to cover all Southeast Asia, Cerruti Vice-President Aurelio Giorgini said.
"This is cooperation for dominating the Southeast Asia markets," Giorgini said.

He said that Cerruti saw Southeast Asia as important for its future operations and expected its current retail sales of $350 million in the region to increase to $600 million within three to four years.

"We don't believe in a simple licensing agreement. We have to transform it into a real partnership," Giorgini said, adding that he did not rule out the possibility of creating a joint venture company within two or three years.
Great River also holds licensing agreements for a number of fashion names including Choya, Kenzo, Elle and Swatch.
